title: Auto-compact at 600k
summary: Compacts the conversation automatically at 600k tokens. Needs a model with a 1M context window.
benefit: Long sessions keep going without hitting the context limit.
solves: Long sessions that stop when the conversation hits the context limit.
use_cases: A long session on a 1M-context model: the conversation is compacted by itself at 600k tokens.
Without a 1M model it does nothing useful: Claude Code caps the value at the model's window.
details: Turns on automatic compaction of the conversation at 600k tokens. It needs a model with a 1M context window; without one, Claude Code caps the value at the model window, so it does nothing useful. It is for long sessions on a 1M model. It changes the autoCompactEnabled and autoCompactWindow keys in settings.json only; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: One setting. Claude Code caps it at the model window, so it does nothing useful without a 1M window.
